components.name: bun
components.notes: Bun and its Rust workspace crates (src/*, 94 crates, none declares a license field). LICENSE.md says "Bun itself is MIT-licensed" and carries no copyright line or MIT text, so Bun's own LICENSE.md ships byte for byte, followed by bun_1.4.2__MIT-terms.txt, the SPDX MIT terms with no copyright line (amendment 045). Each Bun pin bump's completeness review checks whether upstream now ships a full MIT text with a copyright line. If so, switch to that text, drop the terms file and remove its test case. If not, carry the terms file over under the new version's file name.
